title: Virtual DOM diff and in-memory host patch application
description: Reduced conformance and harness slice: reconcile 1,000 nodes with exactly 250 effective edits, then verify self-contained application. This is not the accepted v2 production workload.

inputs.generation: SplitMix64 seed 0xVDOM2026, 1,000 nodes depth <= 8, 250 edit operations

oracle.policy: Exact patch array hash and resulting DOM tree HTML canonical serialization hash
oracle.deadCodeDefense: Patch operations and HTML serialization hash are verified against the frozen oracle.

work.complexity: O(N + 65,536 + child references) with one reusable u16 ID index
